name: Beef Liver
siboNotes: Excellent protein choice for SIBO diets as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides essential nutrients often depleted during bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Soak in milk for 30 minutes before cooking to reduce strong flavor
Cook quickly over high heat to avoid tough texture
Season with low-FODMAP herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Pair with low-FODMAP vegetables for balanced nutrition
nutritionalHighlights: Extremely high in vitamin A (over 500% DV)
Excellent source of iron and B vitamins
High in folate and vitamin B12
